title: Transcript Segment
description: The atomic unit of citation. Every quote in the knowledge base must be a verbatim substring of exactly one segment's text.

segment_id.description: Stable ID: '<video_id>:<start_ms>'. Regenerating the corpus with identical windowing parameters reproduces identical IDs.

source_key.description: Which configured source this segment came from.

url.description: Deep link to the exact timestamp, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>&t=<start>s

caption_kind.description: Auto-generated captions lack punctuation and mis-transcribe jargon; claims grounded only in 'auto' segments are capped at lower confidence.
